{{Quote|Goen through da planet core is bad bombin!|Jar Jar Binks|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
The '''Naboo Abyss''' was the general term used to describe the labyrinth of cavernous tunnels and lava tubes that permeated from the surface of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to its [[Plasma/Legends|plasmic]] core.

==Geology==
The intricate network was formed over many eons as the plasmic [[Magma/Legends|magma]] of the core seethed and simmered away its rocky surroundings. The Abyss was largely submerged in a vast, underground [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]. Plasmic bursts would, at times, heat the [[Water/Legends|water]] to extreme temperatures before erupting on the surface.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Wesa give yousa una bongo. Da speedest way tooda Naboo tis goen through de planet core. Now go.|Boss Nass|<ref name="Episode 1" />}}
[[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] had populated the underwater realm for seven millennia.<ref name="ItWoSWEI" /> Aquatic vehicles, such as the [[Tribubble bongo/Legends|tribubble bongo]], were used for travel purposes. The Gungans dominated the upper regions of these 'underwaterways', which served as highways between their underwater cities: the [[Paonga Strait]] beneath [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]] connected [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] to the Gungan [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|sacred place]].<ref name="Episode I Adventures 11: Pirates from Beyond the Sea">''[[Episode I Adventures 11: Pirates from Beyond the Sea]]''</ref>

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] traveled through the lowest regions of the Abyss (very near to the core) to reach the capital city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on the other side of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], per the request of [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Boss Nass]]. Boss Nass felt secure in the knowledge that they would fail to successfully navigate the treacherous waters.<ref name="Episode 1" />

==Fauna==
{{Quote|Argh! big goobar fish! Huge-a teeth!|[[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]|<ref name="Episode 1" />}}
The Abyss was notorious for its massive, carnivorous beasts. The [[Colo claw fish/Legends|colo claw fish]] and [[Sando aqua monster/Legends|sando aqua monster]] were two of the largest sea creatures to inhabit the region, the latter which grew to sizes exceeding 200 meters. The [[Opee sea killer/Legends|opee sea killer]] made regular use of rocky outcroppings for ambush attacks.<ref name="TNEGtAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

Many species had bioluminescent patterns or patches on their skin, which helped them identify themselves to others, locomote in the dark and attract prey. Others had sophisticated ocular abilities which helped them illuminate the darkness. Most were cold-blooded or had developed surface-area to body mass ratios that would allow them to preserve their body heat and ration energy. The [[Laa/Legends|laa]], [[Yobshrimp/Legends|yobshrimp]], [[Tee/Legends|tee]], [[Mee/Legends|mee]], [[See/Legends|see]], [[Ray/Legends|ray]], and [[Faa/Legends|faa]] all lived in the Abyss.<ref name="TWoSWAFG" />
